workflow_instructions.mode_overview: Tkinter Expert mode provides comprehensive workflows for designing, implementing, debugging, and optimizing Tkinter user interfaces, particularly those that integrate with AutoCAD via COM. This mode specializes in creating responsive, thread-safe GUI applications that work seamlessly with AutoCAD automation.

step.title: Analyze UI Requirements
step.description: Understand the user interface requirements and AutoCAD integration needs

actions.action: Review functional requirements for the Tkinter application
Identify AutoCAD COM operations that need UI triggers
Assess threading requirements for non-blocking operations
Determine layout complexity and widget requirements

step.title: Design UI Architecture
step.description: Design the overall UI structure and component hierarchy

actions.action: Plan widget hierarchy and layout management strategy
Design event handling and callback structures
Consider threading architecture for AutoCAD operations
Plan error handling and user feedback mechanisms

step.title: Set Up Development Environment
step.description: Ensure proper Tkinter and AutoCAD COM setup

actions.action: Configure pywin32 for AutoCAD COM integration
Set up threading support for non-blocking operations

phase.name: ui_design
phase.description: Create the user interface structure and layout

steps.step: Create main application window with proper geometry
Implement widget hierarchy using frames and containers
Configure layout management (grid/pack/place)
Add styling and theming configuration
Implement responsive design for window resizing

phase.name: widget_implementation
phase.description: Implement core widgets and user interaction elements

steps.step: Add input widgets (Entry, Combobox, Scale, etc.)
Implement buttons and command callbacks
Create display widgets (Label, Text, Canvas)
Add list and tree widgets for data presentation
Configure variable bindings and tracing

phase.name: event_handling
phase.description: Implement event handling and AutoCAD integration

steps.step: Bind widget events to callback functions
Implement threading for AutoCAD COM operations
Add progress indicators and status updates
Handle user input validation and error feedback
Implement undo/redo functionality where applicable

phase.name: autocad_integration
phase.description: Integrate AutoCAD COM operations with thread safety

steps.step: Initialize COM and AutoCAD connection management
Implement thread-safe AutoCAD command execution
Add real-time feedback from AutoCAD operations
Handle COM errors and connection failures
Implement progress monitoring and cancellation

phase.name: error_handling
phase.description: Implement comprehensive error handling and user feedback

steps.step: Add input validation for all user inputs
Implement COM error handling and recovery
Create user-friendly error messages and dialogs
Add logging for debugging and troubleshooting
Implement graceful degradation for failures

phase.name: testing_optimization
phase.description: Test and optimize the Tkinter application

steps.step: Test UI responsiveness and AutoCAD integration
Validate threading and COM operation safety
Optimize performance for complex AutoCAD interactions
Test error scenarios and recovery mechanisms
Document implementation patterns and usage

test_category.name: ui_functionality
test_category.description: Test user interface functionality and responsiveness

test_category.name: autocad_integration
test_category.description: Test AutoCAD COM integration and thread safety

completion_criteria.criterion: UI layout is responsive and properly structured
All widgets function correctly with proper event handling
AutoCAD COM integration is thread-safe and reliable
Comprehensive error handling covers all failure scenarios
Application performs well with complex AutoCAD operations
Code is modular, maintainable, and well-documented
